sources.entry: revealjs - Framework for easily creating beautiful presentations using HTML. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Javascript

summary.one_liner: reveal.js is an open source HTML presentation framework that lets anyone create slide decks in a web browser.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes reveal.js as an HTML presentation framework for building slide presentations with a web browser. Its stated feature set includes nested slides, Markdown support, Auto-Animate, PDF export, speaker notes, LaTeX typesetting, syntax-highlighted code, and an extensive API. The README also points to a live demo, documentation, and a visual editor called Slides.com, which it says is made by the same people, though that is a separate product. A paid video course is mentioned as well. The excerpt does not include installation steps, so the install commands are not listed here.
use_cases: build a talk with Markdown slides
add speaker notes to a presentation
include LaTeX math and code samples in slides
how_to_run: See the README's 'Install reveal.js' documentation link for setup steps
notable: LaTeX typesetting and syntax-highlighted code blocks
caveats: The README excerpt does not list install commands or system requirements
The Slides.com visual editor and the video course are separate paid offerings
